# IS Justice Servis

> Accounting, tax, payroll, company formation and mediation for entrepreneurs in Galanta, Slovakia. Run by JUDr. Ivana Stancelová since 2008. Website in Slovak, English and German.

## Identity

- Brand: IS Justice Servis (also written "IS Justice")
- Legal name: IS-JUSTICE Servis s.r.o.
- Type: accounting and business advisory firm (účtovníctvo, dane, právo)
- Address: Puškinova 2474/100, 924 01 Galanta, Slovakia
- Founded: 2008
- Founder: JUDr. Ivana Stancelová, lawyer and mediator (practice since 2003, registered mediator since 2012)
- Company IDs: IČO 44287038, DIČ 2022667394, IČ DPH SK2022667394

- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:00

## Services and prices

Prices are starting prices. Each client gets an individual quote based on the number of accounting entries and the scope of services. Most clients pay 80 € to 450 € per month.

- Single-entry bookkeeping (jednoduché účtovníctvo), for sole traders and small businesses: from 50 € per month
- Double-entry bookkeeping (podvojné účtovníctvo), for companies and VAT payers, consultations included: from 80 € per month
- Payroll and HR (mzdy a personalistika): from 12 € per task
- Tax and advisory services, including tax returns (daňové priznania): from 60 €
- Consultations: 75 € per hour
- Company formation and sale (s.r.o., sole traders, ready-made companies, liquidation): custom quote
- Mediation: commercial and workplace disputes, family mediation (e.g. arrangements for contact with children)
- Cryptocurrency consulting: accounting, tax and legal aspects of crypto in a business
- Real estate: sale, purchase and rental of property, including arranging a bank mortgage
- US LLC formation: referred to the partner usfirma.sk

Free 15-minute consultation (15-minútová konzultácia zdarma). Reply within 24 hours. Service in person in Galanta or online.
